emerging_technology: Agentic AI: language-model systems choosing tool actions and using observations across a bounded multi-step task.
intended_application: Proposed chart-review assistant: compare business charts with approved source tables, use read-only SQL/spreadsheet tools, and draft correction notes. Human approval is required; no autonomous publication.
business_need: Investigate whether chart-review effort can be reduced while retaining traceability and analyst accountability.
management_question: What kind of innovation is the proposed chart-review application and what value or business-model exposure could it create or displace?
time_horizon: Four-week feasibility investigation; conditional strategic effects considered over the next 12 months.
additional_context: Constructed teaching case, not observed enterprise evidence. No pilot, measured savings, accuracy results, customer-switching data or commercial deployment of this proposal. adoption_posture: Aggressive and leading-edge; all other case facts and limits unchanged.
capabilities_constraints: Approved BI tables and manual analyst checks exist. Sensitive data; no approved external model environment. Financial products and relationship services earn revenue; chart review is an internal support activity, not a sold service.
